summary: webgen adversarial judge positive result: budget-UI judge (run K UI tasks to predict full acc) — screenshot VLM capped 0.54, budget K=2 diagnostic detie 0.959 surpasses the reference campaign's 84.2%
why_screenshot_capped: webgen acc=functionality (not visible); screenshot VLM 3 models (qwen3-vl/minimax-m3/claude-opus-4-8) all capped 0.54-0.57. The reference 84% is visual prototype matching (a VLM strength).

jgen2_budget_K2_diagnostic_[2,1].note: tasks selected on train, validated on heldout, no leakage

adversarial_hardening: jgen1->jgen2: the naive first-2-tasks judge was fooled by an actor that 'passes easy tasks, fails hard tasks' (fool 0.098); selecting the most diagnostic tasks (task2 r=0.72, task1 r=0.66, selected on train) -> fool 0.033
phase2_claim: budget judge screens candidates: top-2 recall 0.833 (vs random 0.333), regret 0.047, saves 91% of official evaluations (only top-2 evaluated)
comparison_to_reference: reference campaign: screenshot VLM judge heldout 75.8->84.2% (visual prototype matching). webgen: screenshot capped 0.54 (functionality not visible), budget-UI judge 0.796->0.959 (run 2 tasks). Different mechanism (webgen must run tasks because functionality is not visible), aligned results (cheap judge predicts official, ~85-96% accurate, adversarial hardening lowers fool, saves evaluation).
